item_name: Rothco 3.0 Liter Replacement Bladder With Bite Valve
item_short_desc: Rothco’s 3.0 Liter Replacement Bladder with Bite Valve is an essential accessory for staying hydrated during any outdoor adventure. Designed for seamless integration with Rothco’s 3-liter hydration packs, this bladder ensures you always have a reliable source of water on the go. The bite valve spout allows for quick and accessible drinking, while the shut-off valve prevents any unwanted drips. A bite valve cap ensures leak-free storage, providing peace of mind whether you're camping, cycling, hiking, climbing, or traveling.
description: Rothco’s 3.0 Liter Replacement Bladder with Bite Valve is an essential accessory for staying hydrated during any outdoor adventure. Designed for seamless integration with Rothco’s 3-liter hydration packs, this bladder ensures you always have a reliable source of water on the go.
